strategic_terminal_goal: Ship the personal weak-network VPN with exactly one public TCP-shaped flow per session: one raw FakeTCP-owned SYN/4-tuple, bounded real TLS 1.3 Reality-like setup on that same sequence space, encrypted in-flow phase switch, then same-flow DTLS 1.3/FEC/LINK datagrams with no ordinary-TCP steady-state HOL and no second public connection.
frozen_constraints: The existing FakeTCP sender/receiver/recovery/FEC steady-state data plane is frozen unless a deterministic transport failure proves a change is required.
No second Reality/bootstrap TCP connection, second SYN, FIN/RST, TLS close_notify, or kernel-TCP handoff is allowed at the setup-to-data boundary.
The Linux public WBD_PORT has one WBD owner: raw wbd-faketcp-mux; V3 must not restore a competing WBD kernel TCP listener.
Reality-like ordered stream semantics are bootstrap-only and are destroyed after the encrypted switch ACK; sustained VPN payload remains packet/datagram no-HOL.
Hosted Windows synthetic/ABI qualification must never be represented as a real Npcap/NIC qualification; the explicit physical Windows 11 x64 + Npcap 1.88 gate remains mandatory before delivery.

Do not deliver a new Windows/Linux artifact pair until the exact final V3 behavior has passed both the strong Linux single-flow qualification and a real Administrator Windows 11 x64 Npcap 1.88 capture/injection qualification.
Npcap Free Edition is never redistributed by WBD and is not silently installed.
